answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 14997 Country: India Title: Assalamoalaikum. I have a business of chemical and scientific instruments.My supplies are in various colleges and universities and in industries. please tell me that, "is supplying chemicals and instruments in a wine and Liquar Factory is Halaal or Haraam"? can i supply chemicals and instruments in a wine and Liquar Factory? Question: Assalamoalaikum. I have a business of chemical and scientific instruments.My supplies are in various colleges and universities and in industries. please tell me that, "is supplying chemicals and instruments in a wine and Liquar Factory is Halaal or Haraam"? can i supply chemicals and instruments in a wine and Liquar Factory? Answer ID: 14997 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1655/1325=H/1430) It is lawful and it is allowable to supply the same to liquor factory, but it is better if you avoid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
